pages.raw_title: Sleep Apnea Test at Home | Home Sleep Testing Solutions
pages.raw_meta: NightOwl is a small, efficient sleep apnea test at home that offers 10 nights of recorded data for internight variability and an alternate to in-lab sleep tests
raw_blocks: Resmed diagnostic solutions are designed to help the millions of undiagnosed sleep apnea patients get answers they need, and the treatment they deserve so they can rest. Our Home Sleep Tests (HSTs) empower providers to screen more patients and manage each step of the diagnostic process.
Fully disposable, non-invasive home sleep test – fits comfortably on a patient’s index finger
Records up to 10 nights of data † to help provide an accurate picture of a patient’s sleep health
Comes with an easy-to-follow companion app, myAir, that helps patients through each testing step
Cloud-based home sleep test that automatically syncs patient data each morning to the provider portal
Provides performance and reliability in a compact, lightweight, and easy-to-use device
Records up to five channels of information: respiratory effort, pulse, oxygen saturation, nasal flow and snoring
Works seamlessly with AirView™ to provide a comprehensive sleep diagnostic solution
† Based on average use of 8 hours per night

pages.raw_title: About Resmed | The World Leader in Sleep Health | Resmed
pages.raw_meta: Resmed is dedicated to developing innovative solutions to help people around the world sleep and breathe better. Explore our mission, vision, leadership, career opportunities and more.
raw_blocks: We work every day to help people sleep, breathe and live better.

We’re leading the way in cloud-connected medical devices that transform care for people with sleep apnea, COPD and other chronic diseases. Our comprehensive out-of-hospital software platforms support the professionals and caregivers who help people stay healthy in the home or care setting of their choice.
We create life-changing health technologies that people love.
We envision a world where every person can achieve their full potential through better sleep and breathing, with care delivered in their own home.

We know the power of sleeping and breathing, and we want the world to know it too. We’re raising awareness of sleep apnea, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, or COPD, and other respiratory conditions and delivering meaningful diagnoses and innovative treatments to people around the world.
We help people with sleep apnea get quality, uninterrupted sleep with cloud-connected CPAP devices, equipment and digital health technologies.
We help people breathe easier and manage symptoms of COPD and other respiratory diseases with cloud-connected ventilators and digital health technologies.
We help providers deliver more personalized care, measurable results and improved health outcomes with a network of out-of-hospital healthcare management solutions.

In this video, Kimberly Sterling , Vice President of Medical Affairs, emphasizes the Resmed Foundation ’s curiosity-driven approach and mission to fund novel sleep and breathing research that truly improve lives.

We’re leading the way in cloud-connected medical devices that transform care for people living with sleep apnea, COPD and other chronic diseases. Our comprehensive out-of-hospital software platforms support the professionals and people who help their loved ones stay healthy at home or in the care setting of their choice.

Our leaders are passionate about pioneering the best in sleep health technology while maintaining the highest standards of ethics and quality, to help the world live healthier lives through better sleep and breathing.
